description: A Chrome extension for tracking daily goals with timers, counters, and checkboxes. See FEATURES.md for full specifications.

userStories.title: Optimize icon animation behavior
userStories.description: In the goals screen, Modify the icon animation behavior so that animations only play the first time an icon is interacted with (e.g., when clicking on a goal card, play, pause, etc.). Prevent the animations from replaying on subsequent interactions to enhance user experience and reduce visual distraction.

userStories.title: Fix x-axis clipping in Goal Statistics for last 30 days
userStories.description: In the Goal Statistics section, address the issue where the x-axis labels for the last 30 days are getting clipped or overlapping, making them difficult to read. Ensure that all day numbers are fully visible and properly spaced to enhance readability and user experience.
